environment.origin_header: absent for SDK clients; security.allowed_origins=* for this run (see D05)
environment.notes: no credentials are recorded in this file

scenarios.detail: One durable primary input. input.ack accepted(seq 4) -> delivered(seq 5), message.delta, runtime.execution.completed(seq 7), done(seq 8). SDK reported dones=1. Cost USD 0.0456.

scenarios.before: done carried seq 7 but arrived after runtime.execution.completed seq 8; the monotonic-seq SDK dropped it and the driver timed out with dones=0
scenarios.after: runtime.execution.completed seq 7, done seq 8, in arrival order; SDK dones=1
scenarios.regression: internal/gateway.TestProcessForwardedEvent_DoneArrivesAfterTheRuntimeFactItOvertakes (red before the fix: "1" is not greater than "2")

scenarios.detail: A second input sent mid-turn is accepted as input_mode=injected, durability=volatile, with parent_execution_id set, and is replayed into a genuine second turn: delta + done for turn 1, then delta + done for turn 2.
scenarios.caveat: The Go SDK initially surfaced only turn 1 (issue D02). With that fixed, both turns are observable. The gateway-side ordering deviation in D01 remains.

scenarios.evidence: A recording proxy observed seq 12 (message.delta) and seq 13 (done) on the wire at 09:44:06 while the SDK's last surfaced event was done seq 11 at 09:44:06.320.

scenarios.detail: GET /admin/executions returned delivery_status, runtime_status, worker_run_id, fence_version and a keyset next_cursor for real executions. GET /admin/sessions/pool and DELETE /admin/sessions/{id} behaved as documented.

not_verified: Cron -> occurrence -> execution end to end: no cron jobs are configured in this environment (GET /admin/cron/jobs returned []).
Provider delivery receipts: only the Slack adapter implements receipts (internal/messaging/slack/receipt.go); the configured Feishu bot is legacy-only, so no real external delivery could be observed.
